subject: Reseller entitlement mapping — ACME listing not publishing to GCP Marketplace
messages:
From: Daniel Park <daniel@acmecloud.com>
To: connor_obrien@redwood.com
Cc: Sofia Gomez <sofia@acmecloud.com>
Date: 2028-09-13T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: ACME listing failing to publish to GCP — entitlement mismatch

Hi Connor,

We finished the publisher manifest upload this morning but the listing is not appearing in the GCP partner portal (partner marketplace). GCP support says the entitlement mapping from our reseller SKU -> GCP SKU is failing validation (error: "entitlement mapping key mismatch").

Can Redwood confirm whether you pushed the entitlement mapping back to the publisher manifest after the last quota update? We shipped a new metered SKU on 9/10 and suspect the SKU ids got rekeyed. This is blocking our go-live with the reseller co-sell agreement next week.

Attached: publisher-manifest.csv (export from our portal).

Short ask: can you triage ownership (Redwood listing vs. publisher manifest reconciliation) and tell us the next steps today? If useful, we can jump on a quick screen share.

Thanks,
Daniel Park
Head of Cloud Partnerships
Acme Cloud Partners
(415) 555-0198

[Attachment: publisher-manifest.csv (CSV)]

From: connor_obrien@redwood.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2028-09-13T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: ACME listing failing to publish to GCP — entitlement mismatch

Ben / Olga — looping you in to triage with the Acme team. High level: sounds like a mapping mismatch between their reseller SKUs and the GCP SKU ids Redwood uses when we push listings. We need to confirm which system is the source-of-truth for entitlement ids and whether a prior SKU rename was applied without running the reconcile.

Immediate asks: 1) Ben — can you check the publisher push log for ACME from 9/10–9/12 and share the manifest we submitted to GCP (will be in S3: s3://redwood-publisher-exports/acme/). 2) Olga — can you pull the entitlement reconciliation report from the catalog service and verify whether any SKU renames were applied between v1 and v2.

I attached the external manifest for reference (from Daniel). Let's aim to reply to ACME by EOD with a clear owner and next steps. If we think this is on our end, propose a hotfix window; if it's on ACME, list the exact fields they need to correct.

I can host a screenshare at 4pm PT if helpful — I asked Acme to confirm availability.

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Senior Partner Ops Manager
Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.com

[Forwarded attachment: publisher-manifest.csv (CSV)]

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: connor_obrien@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2028-09-13T11:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: ACME listing failing to publish to GCP — entitlement mismatch

Quick update from me after checking the push logs and the store export:

- I found the push we made on 2028-09-10 at 02:43 UTC. The manifest we submitted (publisher_payload_20280910.json) used SKU ids prefixed with "acme-sku-".
- ACME's new metered SKU in their publisher-manifest.csv is labeled "ACME-MTR-2028-09"; that maps to our internal SKU acme-sku-v2 which in our catalog service shows a canonical id of "acme-sku-7843".
- The error Daniel saw ("entitlement mapping key mismatch") is exactly what happens when the publisher manifest references the human-visible SKU name rather than the canonical SKU id we push to GCP.

Proposed remediation plan (short):
1) Reconcile: create an entitlement-mapping export that matches ACME's visible names to our canonical ids and send to ACME. Attachment: entitlement-matrix-v2.xlsx.
2) Patch push: after ACME confirms the mapping we will re-push the corrected manifest to GCP (target: 9/14 03:00 UTC) and monitor the partner portal for the listing to appear (30–45m window).
3) If the push fails again, escalate to GCP partner support with push logs and the mapping table.

I attached the mapping table and the exact publisher payload we plan to push. Also flagged a minor mismatch in per-seat vs. metered billing fields — ACME's CSV has a column named "units_type" that needs to be set to "metered" to align with GCP's entitlement schema. I'll annotate and send to Daniel.

Let me know if you want me to proceed with the patch push once ACME signs off; otherwise I can wait for Olivia's catalog reconciliation.

Ben Carter
Partner Integrations Engineer
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: entitlement-matrix-v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
[Attachment: publisher_payload_20280910.json (log export)]

From: Daniel Park <daniel@acmecloud.com>
To: connor_obrien@redwood.com
Cc: Sofia Gomez <sofia@acmecloud.com>, partnerships@acmecloud.com
Date: 2028-09-14T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ACME listing failing to publish to GCP — entitlement mismatch

Thanks, Connor and Ben — this is helpful. I've reviewed the entitlement-matrix-v2.xlsx you sent and I've updated our publisher manifest to include the canonical IDs (we replaced the human-friendly names in the "sku_id" column with the canonical ids you provided).

I've attached the revised publisher-manifest.csv and signed the co-sell agreement this morning; DocuSign transaction here: https://www.docusign.com/transactions/XYZ-ACME-2028. The signed PDF is attached.

Next steps from our side: please re-push the corrected manifest to the GCP partner portal and confirm when it is live. We are available for the 4pm PT screenshare today to walk through the manifest and confirm the listing.

Regards,
Daniel

[Attachment: publisher-manifest.csv (updated)]
[Attachment: docusign-co-sell-signed.pdf (PDF)]

From: connor_obrien@redwood.com
To: Daniel Park <daniel@acmecloud.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2028-09-15T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ACME listing failing to publish to GCP — entitlement mismatch

Daniel, thanks for the fast turn-around and for sending the signed agreement.

Plan from Redwood:
- Ben will re-push the corrected manifest to GCP at 2028-09-14 03:00 UTC (we will confirm push ID and provide the push log).
- Olga will run a post-push reconciliation and validate the entitlement schema (units_type, quota definitions) in the partner portal (expected within 45 minutes after push).
- I will coordinate a short screenshare at 4pm PT today to verify the listing visibility and confirm the buyer-facing SKU descriptions.

If the listing does not appear after the re-push, we will escalate to GCP partner support and share the push logs + mapping table immediately. For audit, we will store the final publisher manifest and the push log in the ACME folder in our S3 bucket and share the link with your partnerships mailbox.

Thanks again — I appreciate the quick turnaround. See you at 4pm PT.

Connor O'Brien
Senior Partner Ops Manager
Redwood Inference
[Stored attachments: entitlement-matrix-v2.xlsx, publisher-manifest.csv, docusign-co-sell-signed.pdf]
